articles.summary: FORT LAUDERDALE, FL / ACCESS Newswire / October 6, 2026 / Eco Wave Power Global AB (publ) (Nasdaq:WAVE), a pioneering onshore wave energy technology company, today announced that Founder and Chief Executive Officer Inna Braverman will present at the National Investment Banking Association (NIBA) 153rd Investment Conference, taking place on October 6-7, 2026, in Fort Lauderdale, Florida.
